explain: The toy draws the GELU curve y = x·Φ(x) from arXiv 1606.08415 crossing the zero threshold line with reading name = value, where negative input still leaks through unlike a hard cutoff. The threshold stays still while x moves, which only holds if the curve stays smooth.

questions.q: Predict which negative just below 0 still leaks instead of cutting at 0?
questions.why: Reader expects hard cutoff at zero.

questions.q: Why does the curve near 0 stay smooth instead of kinking at 0?
questions.why: Reader sees no corner at the threshold.

questions.q: Which input far below 0 stays near 0 without ever cutting at 0?
Where is the dip below 0 deepest before rising back toward 0?

title: GELU leaks below zero instead of cutting
